items.title: Strategy Inc sold common stock and bought bitcoin in latest week
items.summary: Strategy Inc sold 2.05 million shares of Class A Common Stock for $283.8 million in net proceeds during the week ended November 8, 2026. The company used $81.9 million of those proceeds to purchase 1,036 bitcoin at an average price of $79,012 per coin, bringing its total holdings to 850,364 bitcoin. Strategy also repurchased 1.89 million shares of preferred stock for $188.3 million and maintained a USD Reserve of $4.77 billion as of November 8.

items.title: Delta Air Lines completes $500 million bond offering due 2029
items.summary: Delta Air Lines completed a public offering of $500 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.500% Notes due November 6, 2029 on November 6, 2026. The company intends to use net proceeds to repay approximately $391 million in Payroll Support Program borrowings, approximately $70 million of equipment notes, and approximately $39 million of Class B Pass Through Certificates, with remaining proceeds for general corporate purposes.

items.source: SEC filing
items.title: Energy Transfer LP prices $2.7 billion senior notes offering
items.summary: Energy Transfer LP announced the pricing of $2.7 billion in senior notes across three tranches: $900 million of 5.450% notes due 2032, $900 million of 5.900% notes due 2037, and $900 million of 6.550% notes due 2057. The offering is expected to settle on November 20, 2026, and the company intends to use net proceeds of approximately $2.68 billion to refinance existing indebtedness and for general partnership purposes.

items.source: SEC filing
items.title: Wisconsin regulator approves rate changes for WEC Energy subsidiaries
items.summary: The Public Service Commission of Wisconsin approved rate changes on November 5, 2026 for Wisconsin Electric Power Company, Wisconsin Gas LLC and Wisconsin Public Service Corporation, subsidiaries of WEC Energy Group. The decision authorized a return on equity of 9.50% and maintained the equity ratio at 53.0% for the 2027-2028 test year.

items.title: Ametek director Gretchen McClain resigns from board
items.summary: Gretchen W. McClain resigned from the AMETEK board effective immediately on November 6, 2026. The company said the resignation is for personal reasons and does not involve any controversy or disagreement.

items.source: SEC filing
items.title: Travelers Companies increases board size to ten and elects Goldwasser
items.summary: Travelers Companies expanded its board of directors from nine to ten members effective November 4, 2026, and elected Lesley Goldwasser as a director. Goldwasser, currently Vice Chairman of GreensLedge Capital Markets LLC, a Raymond James company, was also appointed to the Compensation, Investment and Capital Markets and Nominating and Governance Committees.

items.source: Bureau of Labor Statistics
items.title: U.S. payroll employment rises 165,000 in October; unemployment holds at 4.1%
items.summary: Total nonfarm payroll employment increased by 165,000 in October 2026, above the average monthly gain of 48,000 over the prior 12 months. The unemployment rate remained at 4.1 percent, with 7.1 million people unemployed. Employment gains occurred in professional and business services (+70,000), health care (+42,000), and transportation and warehousing (+25,000).

items.source: Bureau of Economic Analysis
items.title: U.S. trade deficit decreased to $105.0 billion in September 2026
items.summary: The U.S. goods and services trade deficit fell to $105.0B in September from $105.7B in August, as exports grew faster than imports. The goods deficit narrowed by $0.7B to $135.9B, while the services surplus edged down less than $0.1B to $30.9B.
